In the background, there are silhouettes of trees on the left and other street infrastructure (poles, wires) on the right.

The thin wires and background poles exhibit slight waviness and inconsistent thickness, lacking the rigid straightness expected of tensioned cables and metal poles.
The tree silhouette shows some 'clumping' and soft, painterly edges rather than distinct leaves or branches, typical of generative smoothing in dark areas.
